infrastructure.name: Prod K8s Cluster
infrastructure.yaml:
infrastructureDefinition:
  name: Prod K8s Cluster
  identifier: prod_k8s
  environmentRef: prod
  deploymentType: Kubernetes
  type: KubernetesDirect
  spec:
    connectorRef: account.prod_cluster
    namespace: hawkeye
    releaseName: release-<+INFRA_KEY>

infrastructure.name: Prod VMs
infrastructure.yaml:
infrastructureDefinition:
  name: Prod VMs
  identifier: prod_vms
  environmentRef: prod
  deploymentType: Ssh
  type: Pdc
  spec:
    credentialsRef: org.deploy_ssh_key
    hosts:
      - vm-prod-01
      - vm-prod-02
